tie_detail: Feedstock: Arnold states it has 'a relationship with a rare earth mine in China to provide either SmCo alloy or samarium' for its China facility and other sites (Arnold rare earths page, undated). Arnold's 2025 company history lists a 'Joint Venture - Mine, Ganzhou, CN' formed in 2007 by Arnold Magnetic Technologies AG (Lupfig) with GQD for SmCo and other rare-earth raw materials and blocks for Asia, plus an Arnold plant in Shenzhen, China. In Jan 2026 Arnold signed a supply agreement with LCM (UK, USA Rare Earth) and Solvay (France) for Western-sourced Sm, Nd, Pr, Dy, Tb (terms not public). Cobalt origin not disclosed.
